stem.en: The graph shows a runner's distance from the starting line over time. Which statement best describes their motion?

text.en: The runner moves at a constant speed the whole time.

explanation.en: A straight-line distance-time graph means equal distances are covered in equal time intervals - that's the definition of constant speed. A curving line (getting steeper) would mean speeding up; a flat horizontal line would mean standing still.

hints.en: Look at whether the line is straight or curving, not just whether it's going up.
